summary: Defines the manifest, a signed list of every file at an RPKI publication point along with a hash of each. Receivers can use it to detect missing, altered or stale files. It was replaced by RFC 9286.

eli5.summary: A manifest is a signed packing slip listing every file in a folder and its fingerprint. It lets you notice if something has gone missing or been changed. It was later replaced by RFC 9286.

questions: how to detect missing rpki objects
